shortDescription: Updates the organization's default authentication settings

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: auth_custom_frequency
options.description: The custom cookie authentication frequency in days. Required if auth_frequency is CUSTOM_COOKIE.

options.name: auth_frequency
options.description: Defines how frequently users must reauthenticate.

options.name: auto_provision
options.description: Whether to enable SAML-based user auto-provisioning.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: directory_sync_migrate_to_scim_enabled
options.displayName: Directory Sync Migrate To Scim Enabled
options.description: If true, disables legacy LDAP sync to migrate to SCIM-based provisioning.

options.name: kerberos_enabled
options.description: Whether Kerberos authentication is enabled.

options.name: last_sync_end_time
options.description: Timestamp for when the last LDAP directory sync completed (epoch time).

options.name: last_sync_start_time
options.description: Timestamp for when the last LDAP directory sync started (epoch time).

options.name: mobile_admin_saml_idp_enabled
options.description: Whether Mobile Admin can be used as an identity provider.

options.name: one_time_auth
options.description: Controls how one-time passwords are handled when org_auth_type is NONE.

options.name: org_auth_type
options.description: User authentication type. If set to an LDAP-based value, the LDAP configuration must also be valid.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: password_expiry
options.description: Defines how often user passwords expire.

options.name: password_strength
options.description: Enforces minimum password strength for hosted DB user authentication.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: saml_enabled
options.description: Whether SAML authentication is enabled.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present. Only C(present) is supported.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
